title: Mr. Rea’s English Practice Lab Session
description: The canonical format for a Mr. Rea’s English Practice Lab activity. Course and category names are open-ended metadata and are not inferred from folder names.

id.description: Stable session identifier used by direct links such as ?session=types-of-sentences.

course.description: Student-facing course name used to organize the activity library.

category.description: Student-facing category name within the course.

listed.description: Retained for format compatibility. The current student site uses direct activity links rather than a browsable listing.

submissionInstruction.description: Per-session fallback instruction shown when the site configuration does not provide a global submission instruction.

correctIndex.description: Zero-based index into choices. The legacy validator also checks that the index is smaller than the actual number of choices.

explanation.description: Instructional feedback shown immediately after an answer.

reviewTopic.description: Optional skill label used in the final performance-by-skill summary.
